records.entity_id: academic-programs:School of Theoretical and Applied Science:Earth Science Minor
records.title: Earth Science Minor

fields.description: The minor provides students with a firm grounding in physical and historical geology. Students will gain experience in geological cartographic techniques, be able to identify the major minerals and rocks (in the laboratory and the field), and gain practice in geological field techniques. The electives provide an opportunity to explore a wide range of aspects of earth science. Research opportunities in geology and paleontology are available. In addition to students using the Earth Science minor for middle school science or high school earth science certification, the Earth Science minor can also be used to access employment opportunities in the environmental and geological consulting sector, which is thriving in New Jersey, by providing geological skills beyond those acquired within the Environmental Science & Environmental Studies majors, as well as opening doors to studying the geosciences in graduate school.

fields.description: Pause and spend some quiet time in community at the Women’s Center. Quiet Together — Silent Book Club & Silent Space is a weekly evening space to read, study, work, rest, or simply be. From 6–6:30 pm, Silent Book Club participants can settle in, socialize, and share what they’re reading. From 6:30–7:30 pm, the Center becomes a shared quiet space open to everyone, whether you’re participating in Silent Book Club or looking for an hour of peace and quiet. From 7:30–8 pm, participants and Center visitors can optionally talk about their quiet-hour activities. Whether you’re looking for a cozy place to read, a calm space to work, or a chance to decompress, come as you are and enjoy being quietly together. Questions or accommodation requests? Email women@ramapo.edu or call (201) 684-7468.
